{{Otheruses|water}}
{{Image}}
A '''water filter''' was a device used to filter [[Water/Legends|water]].<ref name="TOR">{{TORcite|type=general|Testing Grounds|Dromund Kaas}}</ref> Around the [[Standard year/Legends|year]] [[3643 BBY]],<ref name="Date">{{TOR_dates|1}}</ref> a group of [[Slavery/Legends|slaves]] [[Dromund Kaas rebellion|revolted]] against the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]] on the Empire's [[Capital/Legends|capital]] [[Planet/Legends|world]] [[Dromund Kaas/Legends|Dromund Kaas]]. They took over the area around an [[Unfinished colossus|incomplete statue]] or [[Darth Vowrawn]], making use of several water filters in the area.<ref name="TOR" />
{{GameDSmechanics}}
However, [[Sith Lord/Legends|Lord]] [[Drowl]] of the Empire sent an individual to [[Poison/Legends|poison]] the filters with [[Quell toxin|Quell Toxin]] so that many of the rebelling slaves would die a slow painful death, which Drowl hoped would demoralize the rest and cause them to surrender.<ref name="TOR" />
{{Endgame}}
